run_spm_encode_pieces: run the spm_encode script to encode input text files into SentencePiece token pieces using a model
run_spm_encode_ids: run the spm_encode script to encode input text files into SentencePiece token IDs using a model
run_spm_encode_with_length_filter: run the spm_encode script with min-len and max-len filters to encode only lines within token bounds
run_spm_encode_stdin: run the spm_encode script to encode text from stdin and write encoded output to stdout
run_spm_encode_parallel_files: run the spm_encode script to encode multiple input files in parallel and write to matching output files
